open_points.subject: owner-request arrival and idle-session restart
open_points.text: “An owner request is any request to the owner interface that carries the valid session, whatever its answer; its arrival restarts the 30 minutes” versus “Such a request never arrives in A13 rule 2's sense … it is no owner request and restarts no 30 minutes.”
open_points.question: Does an owner-interface request carrying a valid session restart the idle period when its body fails before the surface can hand it to the session check?
options: It restarts because A13 defines every owner-interface request carrying a valid session as an owner request, whatever its answer.
It does not restart because State 4 defines arrival as handoff to the session check.
open_points.default_guess: Treat handoff to the session check as arrival, so the failed pre-handoff request does not restart the idle period.

witness.initial: An owner session is valid and has been idle for 29 minutes.
events: The owner sends a form request carrying that session's valid cookie.
The owner-interface body stream fails before the form can be handed to the session check.
Two minutes later, the owner sends a well-formed request with the same cookie.
outcomes: Under A13's broad definition, the failed request restarted the 30 minutes, so the later request is admitted.
Under the changed State 4 passage, the failed request was no owner request, so the session has crossed 30 idle minutes and the later request is refused.
witness.observer: The owner, who either continues in the session or is asked to sign in again.

open_points.subject: closing a connection after a pre-handoff body-read failure
open_points.question: Which module closes the connection, and which capability does the service API or owner interface call to do it after its body read fails?
options: The surface that was reading the body closes it directly.
The surface reports the failure to instance_lifecycle, which closes it.
The transport backend closes it automatically when the surface abandons the request.
open_points.default_guess: Have the surface that detects the failed body read close the connection through an explicit transport capability.
